title: Umm Abbad Academy — homepage layout preview

cards.title: Foundations of Tafseer
cards.description: Begin with intention, revelation and Ulumul Qur’an, then explore the sources of Tafseer, early commentators and important works.

cards.title: Surah Yaseen
cards.description: Reflect on revelation, the signs in creation and the return to Allah, with lessons on faith, accountability and the Hereafter.

cards.title: Surah As-Saffat
cards.description: Explore Allah’s Oneness, the angels’ devotion and the stories of His messengers, ending with remembrance, peace and praise.

cards.title: Surah Al-Ankabut
cards.description: Study the trials of faith, steadfastness, fragile worldly supports and the strength of relying on Allah.

cards.title: Surah Luqman
cards.description: Discover wisdom through gratitude, Luqman’s advice, family responsibilities, worship and humble conduct.

cards.title: Surah Al-Muzzammil
cards.description: Reflect on night prayer, measured recitation, patience and reliance on Allah, with guidance for worship within one’s ability.

cards.title: Surah Al-Qasas
cards.description: Follow selected passages about Musa عليه السلام: repentance, trust, modesty, and the qualities of strength and integrity.

cards.title: Surah As-Sajdah
cards.description: Pause over selected ayahs about Allah’s care, listening to guidance and recognising His signs in everyday life.

cards.title: Surah Al Kahf
cards.description: A four-week journey through the trials of faith, wealth, knowledge and power, exploring the nurturing system of Allah in Surah Al Kahf.
